[USER] User decided to start with risotto, stating it sounds amazing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a classic recipe for Risotto alla Milanese featuring saffron and Parmesan cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe details:  
- Ingredients: 1 onion (finely chopped), 3 tablespoons of butter, 400g Arborio rice, 1 cup of white dry wine, 1.5 L beef or chicken broth, 1 pinch of saffron, 1 cup of grated Parmesan cheese.  
- Directions:  
  1. Heat the broth in a saucepan and keep it hot.  
  2. In another large saucepan, melt the butter and sauté the onion until golden.  
  3. Add the rice and stir until coated with butter and translucent.  
  4. Add the white wine and cook while stirring until it evaporates.  
  5. Add hot broth one ladle at a time, stirring continuously until absorbed before adding more.  
  6. After 15-18 minutes, add saffron diluted in hot broth and continue
